notes_for_generators: # Guidance for Round 02 generators and breeder (from Round 01 results)  Round 1 results: 50 ideas scored, mean 60, max 74, none ≥ 90. Criterion averages (/10): c1 Cost 5.2 | c2 Frequency 6.5 | c3 Workaround 6.4 | c4 Compliance 7.2 | c5 Buyer 5.3 | c6 Channel 6.8 | c7 Market gap 4.5 | c8 Buildable 5.3 | c9 Recurring 5.7 | c10 Public pain 7.3  Biggest killers, in order: 1. **c7 Market gap (only 3/50 scored ≥ 7).** Critics knock ideas down hard when an incumbent    already sells to that buyer. Already-served categories seen in Round 1 — AVOID unless you    have a genuinely unserved sub-niche:    - Legionella/water-temperature sentinel monitoring    - HAV trigger-time tags (Reactec in the hire fleets)    - LN2 dewar monitors    - flood-drying remote monitoring    - digital rodent/bait monitoring (Syngenta, Pelsis, Rentokil)    - heating-oil tank gauges    - transport temperature recorders    - fridge/freezer loggers    - void-property monitoring    Look for niches where the only solutions are enterprise-priced or absent, ideally with    evidence of complaints. 2. **c8 Buildable (3/50 ≥ 7).** Keep the sensor dead simple and cheap: temperature, reed/contact,    float/level, tilt/vibration/accelerometer, current clamp, pressure switch, pulse/flow meter,    load cell, PIR, all on LoRaWAN/LTE-M/NB-IoT with no customer IT.
